entries.title: US, UK and Australia to develop underwater drone technology
entries.snippet: The technology, developed under the Aukus military pact, is aimed at protecting undersea cables and boosting naval defence.

entries.title: 'No-one feels safe now': Residents of Romanian city hit by drone share fears
entries.snippet: People have just begun returning to check on their homes in the block that was hit early on Friday morning.

entries.title: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'deeply alarming', MSF warns
entries.snippet: The medical charity's comments come as the head of the World Health Organization visits the region worst-hit by the virus outbreak.

entries.title: Italy bans Kanye West and Travis Scott concerts over security concerns
entries.snippet: Local authorities say the cancellation of other West concerts had played a role in the decision.

entries.title: Oscar-winning Star Wars editor Marcia Lucas dies aged 80
entries.snippet: The film editor and ex-wife of director George Lucas was widely recognised as a pivotal creative force behind the original space trilogy.

entries.title: Ecuador accused of meddling in Colombian election with tariff vow
entries.snippet: Ecuadorian leader Daniel Noboa offers to cancel tariffs after speaking to a right-wing presidential candidate ahead of Sunday's vote.

entries.title: Cuba’s blackouts leave high-rise residents with constant uncertainty
entries.snippet: Will Grant spoke to a 70-year-old widow who says the inability to use her building's elevator during a power outage trapped her and her husband when he needed medical care.

entries.title: Four more men freed from flooded Laos cave after 10 days
entries.snippet: Two of the seven villagers who entered the narrow tunnels in search for gold on 20 May are still missing.

entries.title: Spain's Sánchez digs in after eight years as PM as wave of scandals threatens survival
entries.snippet: Corruption probes of colleagues and relatives have put Spain's premier into a fight for survival.

entries.title: Trump attacks artists dropping out of US Freedom 250 concert and mulls appearing himself
entries.snippet: Performers Young MC, Poison frontman Bret Michaels and country singer Martina McBride raised concerns the event will be political.

entries.title: Ghana's parliament passes anti-LGBTQ+ bill
entries.snippet: Same-sex acts are punishable by jail terms under Ghana's new bill targeting those identifying as gay, lesbian or transgender.

entries.title: US not 'turning back' on Asia allies, but expects them to boost defence, says Hegseth
entries.snippet: The US defense secretary is questioned about US commitment, including further arms deals, at an Asian security summit in Singapore.

entries.title: No deal announced after Trump meeting to make 'final determination' on Iran
entries.snippet: The US president met his advisers, after officials confirmed the US and Iran had agreed a framework of a deal.

entries.title: Ex-US attorney general defends Epstein files handling in congressional probe
entries.snippet: The testimony comes about a month after America's top prosecutor was ousted by US President Donald Trump.

entries.title: How Putin became master of the image
entries.snippet: From enigmatic KGB agent to wartime ruler, this is how Putin has repeatedly reinvented his image, and himself.

entries.snippet: Farmers report thousands of mice per hectare destroying crops and invading homes.

entries.snippet: The brand's first EV has been heavily criticised, with some saying it has abandoned Ferrari's roots.

entries.snippet: South Africa's Madlanga Commission hears about Brazilian butt lift bribe denials and alleged drug heists.

entries.snippet: The Amazon Prime adaptation of Elle Kennedy's ice hockey romance book is an early hit with viewers.

entries.title: Immigrant detainees sue over 'horrific' conditions at Texas ICE facility
entries.snippet: Immigrant detainees accuse the federal government of 'inhumane' abuse and treatment at Camp East Montana in El Paso, Texas.

entries.title: Judge agrees to review Trump's $1.8 billion 'anti-weaponization' fund
entries.snippet: The fund has sparked a broad backlash since it was announced earlier this month, exposing fractures within the Republican Party.

entries.title: PSG wins back-to-back Champions League titles after shootout victory against Arsenal
entries.snippet: Paris Saint-Germain has won back-to-back Champions League titles by beating Arsenal on penalties in a dramatic final in Budapest.

entries.title: Pride celebrations struggle as corporate sponsorships dry up
entries.snippet: Public support for the LGBTQ+ community by corporations has become politically risky, public relations expert says.

entries.title: Carcass of Timmy the humpback whale brought to shore in Denmark
entries.snippet: The humpback whale, nicknamed "Timmy" by German media, died following a controversial failed rescue effort. His carcass had been drifting near the Danish shore for two weeks.

entries.title: Opinion: Pope Leo reminds us of the value of our shared humanity
entries.snippet: Pope Leo's first encyclical voices his concerns about technology and AI. The pope cautions about the illusions AI bots can create, and how important actual human relationships are.

entries.title: Hegseth urges Asian leaders to boost military spending against China
entries.snippet: The U.S. defense secretary said there is "rightful alarm" of China's military build up. But he also struck a more moderate tone on U.S.-China relations – and notably sidestepped bringing up Taiwan.

entries.title: The NTSB tries to keep cockpit audio recordings private. AI is making that harder
entries.snippet: The National Transportation Safety Board temporarily pulled its docket system offline after digital images were used to reconstruct cockpit voice recordings of the pilots in a recent crash.

entries.title: Colombia's untapped wonder: The Mavecure Mountains
entries.snippet: Far from Colombia's tourist hubs, the Mavecure Mountains rise from the Amazon jungle. Once off-limits during conflict, they now draw adventurous visitors to rare wildlife, sacred sites and vast views.

entries.title: Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing takes first foreign tour as leader, with visit to India
entries.snippet: The tour comes as Myanmar's new government tries to consolidate its political position regionally, while continuing to wage a brutal civil war.

entries.title: Do you need SPF 30, 50 or 100? Dermatologists answer your burning sunscreen questions
entries.snippet: PolitiFact asked board-certified dermatologists to answer people's burning questions about SPF. When it comes to sunscreen, they advised buying broad-spectrum sunscreen that's SPF 30 or higher and reapplying regularly.

entries.title: Trump plans to appeal ruling letting importers seek refunds of paid struck-down tariffs
entries.snippet: Businesses big and small have started receiving tariff refunds after the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that President Trump lacked the constitutional authority to impose higher import taxes on goods from nearly every other country.

entries.title: Fact-checking Trump on National Mall's Reflecting Pool renovations
entries.snippet: As President Donald Trump delves into several projects to remake the monumental core of the nation's capital, PolitiFact fact-checks statements he's made about renovations he's ordered for the National Mall's Reflecting Pool.

entries.title: Bus driver charged after Virginia crash kills 5, including family headed to wedding
entries.snippet: A family of four from Massachusetts who were killed when a bus crashed into multiple vehicles in Virginia were traveling to a wedding with a carload of homemade desserts for the celebration.

entries.title: Colombia accuses Ecuador of interfering in its general election
entries.snippet: Colombia's government rejected a move by Ecuador's president to eliminate tariffs on Colombian imports because of a tariff commitment made to an opposition candidate, calling it "deliberate interference" in the ongoing electoral process.

entries.title: U.S. says it stopped a merchant ship trying to breach blockade and reach Iran
entries.snippet: The U.S. military stopped a merchant vessel trying to break through its blockade of Iranian ports by firing a missile into its engine room, the U.S. Central Command said on Saturday.

entries.title: Four men rescued from flooded Laos cave as search continues for 2 others
entries.snippet: Rescue workers in Laos said Saturday they have safely evacuated four villagers trapped in a flooded cave for 10 days.

entries.title: Autopsy planned for dead humpback whale brought ashore in Denmark
entries.snippet: The carcass of a humpback whale, whose life and death captivated Germans for months as the mammal became repeatedly stranded in the Baltic Sea, was dragged Saturday onto a Danish beach.

entries.title: Thousands flock to Vilnius for festival celebrating Lithuania's iconic cold beet soup
entries.snippet: A festival honoring Lithuania's iconic cold beet soup brought tens of thousands of visitors Saturday to its capital city, which was fully decked out in pink.

entries.title: WHO chief visits Congo Ebola epicenter as cases outpace response
entries.snippet: The head of the WHO on Saturday visited eastern Congo's Bunia, a city at the heart of an outbreak of a rare type of Ebola, where the virus is spreading faster than the response despite better-organized health facilities and new aid arrivals.

entries.title: Bus crashes into cars on Virginia interstate, killing 5 people, state police say
entries.snippet: A bus crashed into vehicles slowing for a work zone on Interstate 95 in Virginia early Friday, killing five people and injuring dozens, including the driver, authorities said.

entries.snippet: Vietnam's leader said Friday that the Strait of Hormuz has shown how one flashpoint can throw the rest of the world into turmoil, suggesting that the U.S. and China need to abide by international law to avoid provoking a global crisis as they vie for influence in the Asia-Pacific

entries.snippet: Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket exploded on the launchpad during a test in Cape Canaveral on Thursday. The company, owned by Jeff Bezos, said no one was injured and all personnel were accounted for. But the rocket has a crucial role in NASA's Artemis program to return American ast

entries.snippet: One year ago, a gunman approached an event for young diplomats at the Capital Jewish Museum in Washington, D.C., and killed two young employees of Israel's U.S. embassy. Yaron Lischinsky was 30 years old and Sarah Milrim was 26. They were about to become engaged. Yaron's father,

entries.title: 'The Hero Next Door' highlights overlooked sacrifices of service members
entries.snippet: For more than two decades, Martha Raddatz has reported from the front lines of America's wars, bearing witness to courage under unimaginable circumstances. In her new book, the veteran ABC News journalist turns her attention to the service members, families and everyday Americans

entries.title: Mahjong thriving as players embrace community and connection
entries.snippet: Once a pastime viewed by some as old-fashioned, the game of mahjong is having a moment. In recent years, players of all ages have been strategizing and socializing at mahjong tables from coast to coast. Deema Zein reports on the tile game's resurgence.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Trump says he'll replace artists who backed out of concert with himself
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump called the artists who canceled on the 250th anniversary event "third rate," and said he would headline the event himself.

entries.title: France: Police detain many after PSG Champions League win
entries.snippet: Soccer fans flooded the famed Champs-Elysees and riots took place in the French capital after Paris Saint-Germain won the Champions League final.

entries.title: PSG's team of talents retain Champions League title
entries.snippet: Paris Saint-Germain were unable to score from open play against a resilient Arsenal but won their second successive title on penalties. Luis Enrique has built a team to be proud of at the oil-rich club.

entries.title: Turkey: Ousted CHP leader draws thousands for Ankara rally
entries.snippet: The opposition party and its supporters say a court ruling that ousted Ozgur Ozel is politically motivated to ensure he can't challenge President Recep Tayyip Erdogan in the 2028 election.

entries.title: Film funding bill to support blockbusters made in Germany
entries.snippet: The German government wants to attract more filmmakers and make the country a 'global player' in on-screen entertainment. A new bill would require media companies to make mandatory investments in the film industry.

entries.title: WHO chief visits Ebola epicenter in eastern DR Congo
entries.snippet: Addressing the public from the epicenter of the DRC Ebola outbreak, WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged the residents to stay safe during burials of Ebola victims and called on the infected to seek care early.

entries.title: Germany: Vaping becoming more popular among young people
entries.snippet: A recent study shows that e-cigarettes are becoming increasingly popular among young people in Germany, with even elementary school kids picking up vapes. Health experts are alarmed.

entries.title: What Hungary must do to receive EU funds frozen under Orban
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Peter Magyar and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced a deal that could free up over €16 billion in EU funds for Hungary. Now, Magyar's new government needs to deliver.

entries.title: Laos: Five people rescued from flooded cave
entries.snippet: Seven people who entered the cave last week were trapped inside by flash flooding that blocked their way. Five of them found some days ago have been freed after rescuers pumped water out of the cave system.

entries.title: Russia recalls Armenia ambassador over EU ties
entries.snippet: The recall comes a day after Putin warned Armenia against seeking EU membership and alluded to the "Ukrainian scenario." Armenia historically has strong ties with Russia but has pivoted toward the West in recent years.

entries.title: Malta votes in snap parliamentary election
entries.snippet: Voting is underway in Malta's parliamentary election. Opinion polls show Prime Minister Robert Abela on course for reelection in the shadow of the Middle East crisis.

entries.title: Germany news: Alpine pass reopened after large protest
entries.snippet: Thousands of people took part in the blockade of Brenner Pass, which links Austria and Italy. Meanwhile, a German minister is looking to crack down on screen time for children. DW has more.

entries.title: India news: Myanmar president arrives to boost ties
entries.snippet: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing is on a five-day visit to India, where he will hold talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Meanwhile, Karnataka is readying itself for a Cabinet change. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Iran war: US says ready to resume hostilities, Hegseth warns
entries.snippet: The United States is "more than capable" of resuming the war with Iran, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said as a permanent ceasefire remains elusive.

entries.title: International aid cuts complicate Congo's Ebola epidemic
entries.snippet: The scaling back of development aid has contributed to the inability to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. German organizations are calling for a major spending boost to help stop the spread.

entries.title: Three Latvian mountaineers die on North America's tallest peak
entries.snippet: Three climbers fell to their deaths near a perilous pass on Mount McKinley in the US's Denali National Park and Preserve. One mountaineer was rescued.

entries.title: Shangri-La Dialogue: Hegseth says 'no state, including China,' must dominate Asia
entries.snippet: US Defense Secretary of Pete Hegseth expressed alarm about China's military buildup in Asia. He also said the United States expects its allies and partners in Asia to increase defense spending to 3.5% of their GDP.

entries.title: Top US and Cuban generals meet at Guantanamo Bay
entries.snippet: Amid the deterioration of relations between the United States and Cuba, a top US general held a rare meeting with senior Cuban military officials at Guantanamo Bay.

entries.title: US: Judge rules Trump name must be removed from Kennedy Center
entries.snippet: Trump criticized the ruling, saying the judge "should be ashamed of himself," but will hand the venue over to Congress.
